reader.requirement: At --std 85, in CALL ... USING, a BY CONTENT or BY REFERENCE phrase (BY optional) applies to every following identifier-2 until the next such phrase, and arguments before any phrase are passed BY REFERENCE; the 1985 USING admits only identifier-2 operands under those two phrases, so BY VALUE, OMITTED and literal operands are refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry program-prototype-name-2002: false at 85, so BindCall takes the judgedUpFront arm (every argument's spelling judged before binding, carried mode threaded by CarriedModeAfter)
ConstructRegistry availability of each Format-2-only spelling (BY VALUE, OMITTED, literal/expression operand): refused COBOL0900 at 85, admitted at 2023
ConstructRegistry call-function-identifier-argument-2002 (the 1985 SR4 refusal of a function-identifier operand) in the up-front arm

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: 2023 adds BY VALUE (also transitive) and literal/OMITTED operands; at 85 those are refused, and the transitive mode itself (CarriedModeAfter, the one writer) is the same code at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb131 covers BY CONTENT A B BY REFERENCE C D with BY written; it does not exercise the bare leading default before a later phrase, the BY-less REFERENCE/CONTENT spelling, a subordinate elementary operand, or the refusal of 2002 operand forms.

probes.expected: all by reference with no phrase; USING REFERENCE A CONTENT B C REFERENCE D CONTENT G1 changes only A and D; USING A BY CONTENT B BY REFERENCE C BY CONTENT D G1 changes only A (assumed BY REFERENCE) and C

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the CALL BY VALUE phrase requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 format has only BY REFERENCE and BY CONTENT

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: a literal or expression as a CALL argument requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: refused: BY CONTENT takes identifier-2 only in 1985

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: the omitted-argument facility (OMITTED / OPTIONAL / IS OMITTED) requires COBOL-2002 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: refused: OMITTED is not in the 1985 format

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.5.2.4 GR12  (5.2.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR12

reader.notes: One writer (CarriedModeAfter) threads the transitive mode from an initial BY REFERENCE in both the 85 up-front judgement and the binding loop. All three mixes printed the values GR12 derives, and the 2002-only operand forms are refused at 85.

refuter.evidence: r3pos.cob at --std 85 (refute-1985-033/r3pos-001): the identifier-1 (dynamic) CALL path with ON OVERFLOW, 'CALL PN USING BY CONTENT A TE (I) BY REFERENCE B TE (3) G1', printed 'DYN A=0001 T2=0007 B=0012 T3=0017 G1=0015' (content transitive over a subscripted element, reference transitive over a subscripted element and a subordinate elementary item); the literal path with ON EXCEPTION/NOT ON EXCEPTION and repeated BY-less phrases 'CONTENT A CONTENT B CONTENT TE (1) REFERENCE TE (2) G' printed 'NOEXC / LIT A=0001 B=0012 T1=0007 T2=0017 G1=0025' (all content operands unchanged, the 01 group by reference changed). Degenerate forms refused: 'USING BY CONTENT BY REFERENCE A' COBOL0001 unexpected 'BY'; 'USING A BY CONTENT' and 'USING BY REFERENCE' COBOL0001 unexpected '.'; 2002 operand forms 'BY CONTENT ADDRESS OF A' COBOL0900 and 'BY CONTENT LENGTH OF A' COBOL5506. cite.py: OK §1985:X.5.2.4 GR12 the text is in GR12; OK §1985:X.5.2.3 SR4.
